spec.studio_prompt: A contemporary three-module low-profile sofa measuring 300 cm wide, 100 cm deep, and 75 cm high, featuring rounded rectilinear volumes upholstered in textured oatmeal linen (#c6bfb5 and #bbb0a2). The design rests on a discreet dark recessed plinth (#533f2e). Draped neatly over the middle backrest is an off-white pleated throw (#eae6df) with textured ribbing and fringed ends. Resting against the inner armrest are two accent cushions: a muted blush linen cushion (#b28675) layered behind a warm ochre velvet cushion (#b88a4c) with soft crinkled folds. Seamlessly tailored stitching accentuates the pillowed contours of each modular section.
